newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian Pliva plans 1-for-37 share split.
newsitem.headline: Croatian Pliva plans 1-for-37 share split.

text.p: Croatian pharmaceutical company Pliva d.d. said on Monday it planned a one-for-37 share split as of January 1, 1997.
It said in a press release the company's capital totalling 2.02 billion kuna would be divided into some 20.2 million new A and B series ordinary shares.
Each would have a face value of 100 kuna, instead of 3,700.

All share cerfiticates would also be replaced by new ones reflecting the split. The proposal would be submitted to the annual shareholders' meeting on November 25, Pliva added. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
